how: We read the website of every San Diego wedding planner listed on Lazo (76 listings, 60 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues and a caterer that also sell coordination, bundled budget-package resellers, a multi-service chain's local page and a city park. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or month-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Which San Diego venues have you run a wedding at this year, and how do you handle beach or park permits if we go outdoors?
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate?

picks.name: Bella Mia Exclusive Events
picks.blurb: Bella Mia Exclusive Events is Yvanna Contreras's luxury planning, floral design and styling studio, taking a limited number of weddings each year. Full-service from concept to execution across San Diego, Coronado, La Jolla and the Southern California coast.

picks.name: SISTI & CO. | Wedding Planner & Florist
picks.blurb: Kimberly Sisti meant to become an ancient history professor and instead became a wedding planner and florist who uses history as design inspiration. SISTI & CO. does planning and floral design as one studio, with a fine art aesthetic, for modern couples across Southern California.

picks.name: Willmus Weddings
picks.blurb: Willmus Weddings has planned San Diego weddings since 2015, with tiers from month-of coordination to full planning and design, and photography and videography under the same roof. The site lists awards and says it was voted Best SD Wedding Planners.

picks.name: Valentina Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Valentina Porro plans and produces luxury weddings in San Diego, Rancho Santa Fe and Lake Como, with full-service care for multi-day wedding weekends. The process starts with your story and how you met before any design begins.

picks.name: Crown Weddings and Events LLC
picks.blurb: Susanne Duffy, from the UK with a career in international hotel management, established Crown Weddings in 2000 and brings over twenty-five years of planning and design. A luxury boutique company working from San Diego to Napa Valley and Park City.

picks.name: At Your Side Planning
picks.blurb: At Your Side Planning has planned elopements, weddings and events since 2004, hundreds of them, and lists traditional planning, elopement, micro-wedding, proposal and vow renewal services. The site cites a 2020 San Diego top-10 mention.

picks.name: Brilliant Event Design
picks.blurb: Leila Oberdorfer studied interior design at Purdue and designed nightclubs, restaurants and hotel lobbies in Miami before planning became the job. Brilliant Event Design takes only a handful of weddings each year and handles design, vendors, timeline and execution.

picks.name: Kristine Smith Designs
picks.blurb: Kristine Smith Designs pairs wedding planning with floral design out of El Cajon. Kristine describes her approach as calm expertise and compassion, taking the weight of planning off your shoulders so you can enjoy the engagement.

picks.name: Ivy Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: Over 12 years leading luxury events, split between San Diego, Santa Barbara and Palm Springs, with new destinations sprinkled in. Ivy Weddings and Events is also the founder of Aisle Beauty, a wedding cosmetic brand, and promises to be cool as a cucumber on event days.

picks.name: Giulia Events
picks.blurb: Giulia Gomiero was born and raised on her family's winery in the Veneto and moved to California at ten. Giulia Events in San Marcos offers partial coordination that begins two months before the wedding and includes rehearsal and day-of on-site coordination.

picks.name: Amorology Weddings
picks.blurb: Amorology is a luxury full-service coordination and styling house in San Marcos with over 17 years of event and design experience on the team. It describes itself as detail-driven and built for a creative, discerning clientele, with the couple's own relationship as the design starting point.

picks.name: To La Lune Events
picks.blurb: Christy is the lead designer and coordinator behind To La Lune Events in Encinitas, a Southern California native and UC San Diego graduate. Full planning, design and prep is sold as the Full Moon Collection, with lighter options for couples who need less.
